      - article:
        - heading "THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Let G be a connected undirected graph with n ≥ 2 vertices.
        - strong:
          - text: Euler circuit (closed path) exists ⇔
          - text: Every vertex has even degree.
        - strong:
          - text: Euler path (open path) exists ⇔
          - text: Exactly two vertices have odd degree.
      - article:
        - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
        - generic: If more than two vertices have odd degree, no Euler path exists.
        - paragraph: Euler trails concern edges; vertices may be visited more than once.
